meta.title: Mouse controller
meta.description: Human-like mouse control that requires a screen_viewer screenshot before every pointer action (coordinate check), again after it (effect verification), and before actively stopping a task. done/stop return a task progress report (instruction, step N/M, pointer action count, elapsed time). The top-right overlay shows "dsh鼠标接管中" plus the task and step while running, and "未操控" once the task ends; Ctrl+D+S+H stops the takeover.
